result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main defect is misaligned cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel. There are also a few minor styling and accessibility concerns.

issues.description: The cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are not aligned. The first card (Green Bowl Poké) has a taller image starting at y≈631, while the second and third cards have shorter images starting at y≈658. Their titles and delivery text therefore sit at different vertical positions (801 vs 829). The image sizes are inconsistent and the row looks broken.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel card images the same fixed height and top alignment so the titles and delivery info line up on one baseline.

issues.description: The time badges overlap the bottom-left corner of the images inconsistently. On the first card the badge extends past the image edge and overlaps the plate, and its position relative to the image differs between cards.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the badges at a consistent inset inside the image bounds on every card.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (delivery fees, inactive tab labels, placeholder text) has low contrast against the white and light gray backgrounds. The heart icon on the second popular card (-20%) sits on a semi-transparent dark circle, unlike the first card, which has no circle.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1). Use the same favorite-button style on every card.

issues.description: The promo banner has decorative circles that are cut off and slightly clash with the banner's rounded corner in the bottom right. This creates a visible edge artifact.
issues.suggestion: Clip the decorative shapes cleanly to the banner's rounded bounds, or simplify them.
